the Juvenile Justice Act itself differentiates between offences falling into three categories, i.e., petty, serious and heinous offences.

The concern of the victim's family and the larger interest of the society cannot be dealt with in a contemptuous manner.
In succession to aforesaid observations, the policy of the act must be brought into focus.
